description: Armis Centrix for Asset Management and Security is a solution that helps organizations manage and secure their connected assets across IT, OT, IoT, medical device environments whether they are physical, virtual or a combination. Itprovides capabilities for asset discovery, classification, and tracking to improve visibility and support informed decision-making. The solution includes analytics and security features for real-time monitoring, threat detection, and response, helping organizations reduce cyber risks and maintain operational efficiency. It integrates with existing IT and security systems to support comprehensive asset governance and risk management.
